falsification_conditions.condition: S&P 500 closes above 5,600 on any single day within 14 days
falsification_conditions.what_it_would_mean: A decisive breakout above the August 2024 recovery high would invalidate the bottom pattern match, as it demonstrates the correction already ended and we're in a new uptrend, not basing

falsification_conditions.condition: VIX closes below 12.50 for 3 consecutive trading days
falsification_conditions.what_it_would_mean: Sustained complacency at pre-correction levels would falsify the bottom thesis, as genuine bottoms require elevated uncertainty and fear to mark capitulation; this signals the 'bottom' was merely a pause in an ongoing bull

falsification_conditions.condition: 10Y-2Y Treasury yield curve steepens to +50 basis points or wider
falsification_conditions.what_it_would_mean: A normalization of the curve without recession realization would invalidate the macro bottom call, as the pattern similarity to August 2024 depends on recession-scare dynamics; steepening here implies soft-landing resolution, making the 'bottom' comparison false

doctrine: If you can't list what would prove your call wrong, you don't have a real call.
